species.tagline: The dragonfly that flies furthest of all

tasks.title: Look at the wings
tasks.message: Its hindwings are unusually broad, so it can glide on the wind.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a globe skimmer. Its broad hindwings let it ride the wind.

tasks.title: How far it goes
tasks.message: Some globe skimmers cross whole oceans — the furthest-flying insect on Earth.
tasks.subtitle: Globe skimmers ride the wind across the sea. No insect travels further.

tasks.title: How to help
tasks.message: Its young grow up underwater, and they need it clean.
tasks.subtitle: Baby dragonflies live in water. Clean water lets them grow. Thank you!
